GuideGentIntroText:
You're a rookie
trainer, aren't you? I can tell!

That's OK! Every-
one is a rookie at some point!

If you'd like, I
can teach you a few things.
GuideGentPokecenterText:
This is a #MON
CENTER. They heal

your #MON in no
time at all.

You'll be relying
on them a lot, so

you better learn
about them.
GuideGentMartText:
This is a #MON
MART.

They sell BALLS
for catching wild

#MON and other
useful items.
GuideGentRoute30Text:
ROUTE 30 is out
this way.

Trainers will be
battling their

prized #MON
there.
GuideGentSeaText:
This is the sea,
as you can see.

Some #MON are
found only in water.
GuideGentGiftText:
Here…

It's my house!
Thanks for your company.

Let me give you a
small gift.
GuideGentPokegearText:
#GEAR becomes
more useful as you add CARDS.

I wish you luck on
your journey!
GuideGentNoText:
Oh… It's something
I enjoy doing…

Fine. Come see me
when you like.
